events.title: Early concept artwork
events.summary: Here’s a look at early concept art created to help shape the cult mask in The Order of Serenity. I commissioned an artist to explore different visual directions for the mask, with the goal of finding something disturbing, ritualistic, and memorable for the cult’s identity.After reviewing the concepts, I chose design B as the main direction and had it modeled by an art director for the game. events.title: Demo Update 1.02 is now live.
events.summary: This update adds gamepad support for the inventory menu, in game menus, and several gameplay interactions.I also added more explanatory information for the chamber mechanics to help players better understand how this part of the demo works.Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared feedback. More improvements are coming.

events.title: The Order of Serenity Demo Now Available
